title: IEP Meeting Prep Checklist
subtitle: Capture meeting notice, current plan, progress evidence, and participant role; confirm family priority and proposed action.
description: IEP Meeting Prep records meeting notice, current plan, progress evidence, participant role, family priority, and proposed action. IEP Meeting Prep evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this iep meeting prep stage-gated verification when staff must document meeting notice and current plan. Reconcile progress evidence, participant role, family priority, and proposed action before the iep meeting prep handoff. Use the meeting notice, current IEP, service log, progress-monitoring data, evaluation reports, family agenda, participant list, draft proposal, and prior written notice route. For iep meeting prep review use, cite source. Match the iep meeting prep family or learner wording. Preserve the iep meeting prep amendment history and supersession date. Link the iep meeting prep source version and meeting notes. Record the iep meeting prep learner response and accessibility support. Close the iep meeting prep recipient list. Verify iep meeting prep documentary provenance. Resolve iep meeting prep amendments, superseded wording, and archival distribution for iep meeting prep. Ask the assigned iep meeting prep reviewer to confirm meeting notice against the organization's policy.

items: Meeting notice is identified for this record
Current plan matches the current request or source
Progress evidence is ready for point-of-use staff
Participant role limits or questions are resolved
Family priority is communicated to the responsible person
Proposed action is confirmed at handoff
A changed iep meeting prep fact is returned for review
